body.objective: Promote a passing two-field compensator charge stratum, if one exists, into the complete action-derived BV, causal, pairing, charge and relational-clock test on the cylinder and Berger fixtures.
body.stop_condition: Import the terminal two-field charge-matrix preflight.  If it selects no exact healthy action/representation locus, close as NOT_ACTIVATED and preserve the preflight's scope.  Otherwise choose only its certified minimal Smith-normal-form charge representatives and coupling components.  Derive the complete reducible Diff/Weyl/compact-U1 BV complex and action Hessian; verify Q^2=0, cyclicity and all Noether identities.  Reduce constraints exactly, classify physical scalar/vector inertia and characteristic/Jordan data, construct support-aware retarded/advanced Green homotopies, and compute raw D, K_Berger, total gauge and relative-phase charges.  Construct at least one explicit gauge-invariant relational phase observable and prove whether it evolves nontrivially while the total compact charge vanishes.  A pass requires elimination of the dressed-trace class, a healthy reduced physical pairing, a complete causal parent and a nontrivial relative clock; a stationary neutral configuration alone is insufficient.
body.current_gate: two-field compensator physical BV and causal completion
body.forbid: no activation on an empty preflight locus; no individual gauge-charged phase called observable; no total-charge cancellation assumed without the Gauss equation; no unreduced Hessian sign theorem; no formal inverse called causal; no nonlinear, QME, particle or unitarity promotion
activates: nonlinear and quantum imports only on a full pass
body.resource_hint: CONDITIONAL FULL GATE.  Inspect the preflight disposition before constructing any large carrier.
notes: The key new possibility is a gauge-invariant relative phase at zero total compact charge; it must be constructed rather than inferred from field count.
